customCommands.name: improve
customCommands.description: Systematically audits a project's overall health across code quality, architecture, performance, maintainability, security, and test coverage, generating a structured IMPROVEMENTS.md tracking document.
customCommands.prompt: Please execute the codebase health audit and planning workflow (/improve): 1. Pre-flight verification & baseline discovery (`python scripts/check_health.py --json`). 2. Six-dimensional health audit following `references/audit-dimensions.md`. 3. Generate structured `IMPROVEMENTS.md` tracking document following `references/improvements-template.md`.

customCommands.description: Executes the complete, end-to-end codebase audit, atomic implementation, test verification, git commit loop, remote push, and CI monitoring in a single autonomous pipeline.
customCommands.prompt: Please execute the full-loop codebase audit and improvement pipeline (/improve-all): Phase 1 to Phase 5 following `SKILL.md` and `references/execution-loop.md`.
